templates.name: OpenTelemetry application by OTLP
templates.description:
Copy of the official "Generic OpenTelemetry by OTLP" limited to one application: every Telemetry query item only reads telemetry whose resource attribute service.namespace is {$OTLP.NAMESPACE}. Link it to one host per application and set {$OTLP.NAMESPACE} on the host.

Generated by scripts/build-otlp-app-template.py (zabbix-apm-dashboard); do not edit by hand.

discovery_rules.name: Browser: pages
discovery_rules.description: Pages loaded in real browsers, from the page loads: every page has its error count, 0 until it fails.

item_prototypes.name: Browser {#SERVICE}: errors on {#PATH}
item_prototypes.description: Errors of the page itself in the interval.

trigger_prototypes.name: Browser: errors on the page {#PATH} of {#SERVICE}
trigger_prototypes.description: The page raised more than {$BROWSER.ERRORS.MAX} errors (uncaught exceptions, rejected promises) in 5 minutes in the browsers of its users. The link opens them, grouped, with the sessions affected.

discovery_rules.name: Browser: requests
discovery_rules.description: Requests made by real browsers, from all of them: every request has its failed count, 0 until it fails.

trigger_prototypes.name: Browser: requests to {#HOST}{#PATH} fail in {#SERVICE}
trigger_prototypes.description: More than {$BROWSER.REQUESTS.FAILED.MAX} requests made by the browser failed in 5 minutes. The link opens the requests that fail, with the trace down to the backend service that failed.

triggers.expression: (max(/OpenTelemetry application by OTLP/otlp.span.status.unset,{$SPAN.NODATA})=0 and max(/OpenTelemetry application by OTLP/otlp.span.status.ok,{$SPAN.NODATA})=0 and max(/OpenTelemetry application by OTLP/otlp.span.status.error,{$SPAN.NODATA})=0) or nodata(/OpenTelemetry application by OTLP/otlp.span.status.unset,{$SPAN.NODATA})=1
triggers.name: OpenTelemetry: No spans received
triggers.description: No span of the application arrived for {$SPAN.NODATA}, or the span counts are not being collected: check that the application and the collector are running and the state of the "Span: ... count" items. It closes by itself when spans arrive again.
